summary: The projection-section argument, the repaired limiting proof of the arbitrary-generator zonotope formula, the Cauchy-Binet projection-volume bound, the lattice-rank argument, and all endpoint and monotonicity claims are correct. The cited Rogers-Shephard inequality applies with the stated dimensions and constant, and Shephard's zonotope formula has the required 2^q normalization; the Hausdorff-continuity argument validly extends it to zero, parallel, repeated, and oppositely signed generators.
